text.content:
This landing marks the last point where retreat is still simple - past here, the Middens close in.

GM Notes

Milestone: A sign of the floor's deeper story: Somewhere in the Larders, the Wool-Crowned King and his stolen throne of saddlebags is handing out promotions based entirely on who the llamas nuzzle first.

Secret: Hidden here: leverage against the Wool-Crowned King and his stolen throne of saddlebags that the floor's story doesn't want found.
